message.content:
The tests failed because of a typo in the unit table in `duration.go`. The `'m'` (minute) unit was mapped to `time.Second`, so "45m" parsed as 45 seconds and "1h30m" as 1h0m30s.

I changed that entry to `time.Minute`. The test suite now passes.
